title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.35453v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated. In this Perspective, we argue for a fundamental shift from data aggregation to experience aggregation. We propose Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework in which distributed AI agents operating across healthcare institutions synthesize collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters. translated_title: 超越联邦学习：面向自我进化临床智能的去中心化智能体系统
translated_abstract: 临床专业知识本质上是分布式的：它并不存在于任何单一数据集或机构中，而是蕴藏在数千名临床医生在应对多样化患者群体、资源限制和不断演化的治疗方案过程中所积累的推理经验之中。然而，当前扩展医学AI的方法——从中心化大语言模型到联邦学习——仍然固守以数据为中心的范式，将知识视为需要聚合的静态参数。在本展望文章中，我们主张从数据聚合向经验聚合的根本性转变。我们提出了去中心化智能体系统，这是一个分布式AI智能体框架，这些智能体运行于各医疗机构之间，通过共享抽象化的推理轨迹而非原始数据或模型参数来合成集体临床智能。与联邦学习在同类模型架构间平均数值梯度不同，DAS……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出从数据聚合转向经验聚合的去中心化智能体系统（DAS）框架，使分布在不同医疗机构的AI智能体通过共享抽象化推理轨迹（而非原始数据或模型参数）来合成集体临床智能，从而实现自我进化的临床智能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework that fundamentally shifts from data aggregation to experience aggregation, enabling distributed AI agents across healthcare institutions to synthesize collective, self-evolving clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters.
